bullets.text: Added `archiveSession()` and `unarchiveSession()`, and an `archived` field on the sessions that `listSessions()` and `getSessionInfo()` return
Added `refuseIfBusy` to `Query.reloadPlugins()` so a host can have a reload refused while the session is busy
Added `managed_lock` to `plugin_errors` entries on `system/init`, naming the managed `enabledPlugins` entry that dropped a plugin copy
Added a `system/informational` warning, tagged `hook_no_verdict`, when a `PreToolUse` hook can't run or answer, or times out, without refusing its tool call
Added `invalid_config_file` to the `config_file_invalid` startup failure result: the broken config file's path and its backup's path as fields
Fixed deny rules (`disallowedTools`, `permissions.deny`, `always_deny`) that name an in-process SDK MCP tool or its server, or match it with a glob, leaving it in Claude's tool list and `system/init`
Fixed `supportedEffortLevels` in model info listing effort levels above the organization's effort cap or the `maxEffortLevel` setting
Changed the `sandbox` option: sandboxed Bash commands are no longer auto-approved unless `autoAllowBashIfSandboxed: true` is set
Changed read-only git commands in a repository that isn't the working directory's, an additional directory's or a trusted one to go through the permission flow instead of being auto-approved
Changed `applyFlagSettings()` to reject when a value would make Claude Code discard its settings layer, applying nothing and keeping settings from earlier calls
Changed `suggestions` on `canUseTool` for Bash and Monitor: a list of rules alone is sent only when saving it would allow that command
Changed the `ProposeSkillsInput` type: a proposal can carry `edits`, and `skillMd` is optional
Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.325
Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.324
Added `machinePolicy.didNotLoad` (alpha) to `resolveSettings()`'s result, which tells a host when a machine policy source may be there and did not load
Added `matchDeniedModels()` (alpha), which tells a host which models a `deniedModels` list blocks, by Claude Code's own entry rules
Added the periodic `tool_progress` heartbeat while a turn waits on long-running hooks; `tool_name` is the hook event, `tool_use_id` begins `hook-`, `parent_tool_use_id` may name no tool call
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AGENT_PROGRESS_SUMMARIES`: set to `1` to turn off subagent progress summaries even when `agentProgressSummaries` is `true` (available since 0.3.318)
Added `tool_use_result` to a subagent's WebSearch result message when the search did not run or found nothing
Fixed progress notifications from SDK MCP servers being dropped for tool calls that were still running when the set of SDK MCP servers changed

Fixed `resolveSettings()` keeping its first reading of a macOS MDM profile or Windows registry policy for the life of the process: it now re-reads after 30 minutes, and sooner after a read that failed
Fixed `forkSession()` with `upToMessageId`: forking at a compaction summary no longer brings back the messages kept after it, and forking at a compaction boundary keeps the conversation before it
Fixed `getSessionMessages` leaving out a queued prompt that directly follows a compaction summary
Fixed `canUseTool` suggestions including a Bash allow rule for commands that write to sensitive paths such as `.git` or `.claude`, where the rule did not stop the next request
Fixed most `initialize` options, such as agents and skills, being ignored when a `SessionStart` hook supplied the first message
Fixed an MCP server removed and re-added with `setMcpServers()` staying `needs-auth` with no tools when a tool call had tried to reach it in between
Fixed `init.plugin_errors` omitting a plugin that only project settings enable but that isn't installed; it now reports it as not installed, with the install command
Changed `init.plugin_errors` to also list load errors of plugins that managed settings enable; a check on it can trip before the background install ends (`CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_PLUGIN_INSTALL=1` waits)
Changed `supersedes` on assistant messages to also be sent after a response whose tool call could not be parsed
Changed what happens when a tool's permission check fails with an error after a `PreToolUse` hook allowed the call: it now goes to `canUseTool`, or is refused when there is no callback
Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.323
Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.322
Fixed `canUseTool` getting the app's own PreToolUse hook reason in `decisionReason` when another hook also asked
Fixed a PreToolUse hook's `ask` being lost when another hook's `defer` finished first and could not be honored
Fixed every hook being dropped when one event in the `hooks` option is set to `undefined`
Fixed `WarmQuery.query()` with a string prompt hanging after `startup()` with `resume` when the resumed session finished a turn of its own before the prompt was sent
Fixed `setMcpServers` closing a folder's `.mcp.json` or local-scope MCP server when passed an in-process server of the same name, in sessions bound with `SpareProcess.claim()`
Fixed `reloadSkills()`, `reloadPlugins()` and `system/init` dropping project skills, commands or agents that a worktree lacks after Claude entered it
Fixed sessions hanging on save, and `importSessionToStore()` never rejecting, when memory ran out while a transcript was being read
Improved `resume` and `continue` on the bundled Claude Code binary: `initialize` is read during boot, so start-up work is less likely to run before your hooks are registered
Changed queued subagent reports in auto mode to share one model call: each keeps its own message and result, and all but the last end in an empty `result` with `num_turns: 0`
Changed an SDK MCP server named `claude-in-chrome` to follow the organization's Claude in Chrome policy: where the policy denies it, the server is not connected
Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.321
Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.320
Added MCP task support in SDK sessions (not on Bedrock, Vertex or Foundry): with `CLAUDE_AUTO_BACKGROUND_TASKS=1` and streaming input, an MCP task runs in the background with `task_type` `"mcp_task"`
Fixed the OpenTelemetry `claude_code.session.count` metric counting `prewarm()` processes that were never claimed; a pre-started process now counts once, when `SpareProcess.claim()` succeeds
Fixed `session_writes_lost` listing the wrong session in `transcript_session_ids` after `/clear` in a session resumed from a transcript file outside the projects folder
Improved `deleteSession()` to reject with `ENOTEMPTY` if the session's folder could not be fully deleted
Changed `session_writes_lost` to be sent only when the CLI exits 0; a run that ends on an error result now gets only the stderr line
Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.319
Added an optional `credential_expires_at` field to result messages: when the stored claude.ai sign-in in use ends
Added the `config_file_invalid` startup failure reason, reported when a configuration file read at startup isn't valid JSON
Fixed the interrupt response missing a message held behind a model change: it is now listed, cancelled with `cancel_queued`, and stopped at start-up as a queued message is
Changed `agentProgressSummaries`: while the subagent waits for a response on a likely-cold prompt cache, a summary can wait up to 5 minutes, and is not sent if the subagent ends first
Changed `status` in `PushNotificationInput` to optional
Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.318
Added `onFailure` to hook matchers: with `"block"`, a hook that throws or returns invalid output blocks the action
Added a warning message in the stream when a hook callback fails
Added a `session_writes_lost` system message, sent after the last result when a full disk or disk quota kept the CLI from saving the session transcript or ~/.claude.json
Added `initialize_not_first` to `startup_failure_reason`, for a `--await-initialize` launch whose first stdin line is not the initialize request
Added `task.description` to the TaskCreate tool's `tool_use_result`: the description the task was created with
Added `lossy` to `readFile()` utf-8 answers: `true` when decoding replaced bytes that are not valid UTF-8
Removed the `file_unchanged` variant of `FileReadOutput` in `sdk-tools.d.ts`; a repeated Read now returns the file content
Fixed `setMcpServers` closing a folder's `.mcp.json` and local-scope MCP servers in sessions started with `prewarm()` and bound with `SpareProcess.claim()`
Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.317

Added `permissions.blockReadsExemptPaths` to the `Settings` type: paths, read only from `--settings` and settings the host sends, that `blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` lets through without making them working directories
Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.316
Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.315
Added `sandbox_required_unavailable` to `startup_failure_reason`, for the result Claude Code writes when a required sandbox cannot run
Added `permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories` to the `Settings` type
Added `prewarm()` (alpha) to the `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/core` entry point
Fixed a settings file left out of `settingSources` still supplying some settings, such as auto mode rules and saved permission consents
Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.314
Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.313
Added `autoMode`, `skipAutoPermissionPrompt`, `useAutoModeDuringPlan` and `permissions.disableAutoMode` to the `Settings` type

Added `unanswered` (`skipped`, `replied_in_chat` or `dismissed`) to AskUserQuestion answers' per-question `annotations`; send it only when `system/init` lists the `ask_user_question_unanswered_v1` capability

Fixed `resolveSettings()` returning mistyped managed auto-mode settings, such as `permissions.disableAutoMode: true`, as written instead of reading them as the CLI does; a user or project settings file whose auto-mode keys hold an invalid value is now skipped, as in the CLI
Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.312
Added `cacheCreationEphemeral5mInputTokens` and `cacheCreationEphemeral1hInputTokens` to `ModelUsage`, splitting `cacheCreationInputTokens` by cache lifetime
Changed background start-up work to wait until the first model request is sent, for about 10 seconds at most, when the first message arrives during start-up
Changed the minimum supported Node.js version from 18.0.0 to 18.14.0
Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.311
Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.310
Fixed host-supplied `managedSettings` dropping `disableAllHooks`, `disableSkillShellExecution` and empty `allowedHttpHookUrls` / `httpHookAllowedEnvVars` lists
Changed `extractFromBunfs()` to extract the embedded CLI into its own per-user temp directory (`claude-agent-sdk-<uid>`, or `claude-agent-sdk` on Windows) instead of Claude Code's temp root
Changed `extractFromBunfs()` to reuse an already-extracted file only when its bytes match the embedded binary, replacing it otherwise
Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.309
Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.308

Added `wakeup_source` to the `command_lifecycle` `started` frame of a scheduled wakeup or task, and `scheduled_for` for a wakeup (capability `lifecycle_wakeup_source_v1`), so a host can tell which one fired
Added `supportedDialogKinds` to browser SDK `query()`, sent on `initialize`; a non-empty list requires `onUserDialog`
Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.307
Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.306
Added `recommendations` and `fix` to the `get_usage` response's behavior windows
Fixed servers set with `setMcpServers` being replaced later in the session by a same-named server from the user's own settings
Fixed `startup()` with `initializeTimeoutMs: null` counting time spent in SessionStart or Setup hooks against its 60-second limit; `null` now works like leaving the option out
Changed the `startup()` and `prewarm()` timeout error for a start with no open SessionStart or Setup hook: it lists possible causes and no longer says to check authentication and network
Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.305
Added `suspendSseStream(query)` and `resumeSseStream(query)` to the browser SDK: close a query's event stream and reopen it later without ending the query
Added stable row ids to `getContextUsage()`, and, when the CLI answers on its own stdio, plugin ids, agent and skill file paths, and per-server MCP instruction token shares

Fixed `startup()` timing out while a SessionStart or Setup command hook was running when no `initializeTimeoutMs` is passed: up to 10 minutes of that time no longer counts toward the 60-second limit, and the timeout error now says what the process reported
Fixed `startup()` keeping every `hook_progress` message of a running SessionStart or Setup hook in memory until it resolved; it now keeps only the newest one for each hook
Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.304
Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.303
Fixed structured output results delivering a response's output as `structured_output` when the API refused that response; the result is now an error with no payload
Changed an omitted `permissionMode` to start in `default` mode on third-party providers, with telemetry off or on a fresh install; pass `permissionMode: 'auto'` to keep auto mode
Changed fork subagents (`subagent_type: "fork"`) to be on by default in SDK sessions, as in the terminal; `run_in_background` is still offered, and `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0` turns them off
Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.302
Added per-tool permission policies to sdk-type MCP server configs: `tools` entries with `permission_policy` `always_ask` or `always_deny`, applied on `initialize` and `setMcpServers()`
Added `BUILTIN_TOOL_NAMES` and `LEGACY_TOOL_NAME_ALIASES` exports: the public built-in tool names and their earlier names, for checking permission rules and tool settings
Added `addPlugins` to `Query.reloadPlugins()` so a host can load more plugin folders into a running session
Fixed `setModel()` with a model ID failing while the account is at its five-hour or weekly usage limit; the model now applies and the next message reports the limit
Changed the error when a full disk keeps the login from being refreshed: `error` is now `invalid_request`, not `authentication_failed`, and `api_error_status` is `null`, not 401
Changed `mcpServerStatus()` to still report a tool's `_meta.ui.visibility` when the rest of its `_meta.ui` fails validation
Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.301
